svg.text: Vias (33 off, 0.40) not shown on view
1. The 29.0 x 10.5 notch is INTENTIONAL. It is antenna clearance
for the DevKitC, which overhangs it. Rout exactly to Edge.Cuts.
3. Ground poured both layers, excluded above Y61.0.
4. NO carrier mounting holes by design. The board sits on an
enclosure ledge and is clamped by ribs on the lid.
5. The four NPTH holes are clearance for the daughterboards,
not fixings for the carrier itself.
6. Tightest copper clearance 0.295, at the J1 right pin row.
